name: UIkit Grid Layouts
description: Provides UIkit 3 based Layout API plugins (1-4 column grids) with background, padding, gutter and alignment options.
project_description:
This module brings a collection of layouts which takes over the UIkit 3 Grid system (1 column / 2 columns / 3 columns...)

 Back to top 

 Recommended Theme 
 This module requires the UIkit Drupal Base Theme (or that you load the UIkit 3 library by yourself).

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.

See: https://www.drupal.org/node/895232 for further information.

 Back to top 

 Configuration / usage 
 This module is designed to work with the core layout builder module but can work with all modules using the layout API like Display Suite or Panels. When you use the Layout builder, just choose the desired layout and configure the section's options.

 Back to top 

 Customisation 
 If you need to adjust the component to your needs, simply override the layout templates using TWIG logic attributes.

 Back to top
